title: Written order, prior authorization and coverage verification terms by tier: Urology and Continence Supply Program
content:
Larkfield's intake and benefits verification standard for the Urology and Continence Supply Program sets, for every tier, how long a prescriber's written order stays valid, whether the payer requires prior authorization and on what timing, how recently coverage must have been verified, and how long the referral documentation may take.

## Terms

- **Order validity**: the validity of the prescriber's written order, in calendar months counted from the order date.
- **Prior authorization required**: whether the payer requires prior authorization before this product line ships.
- **Authorization validity**: the validity of a payer prior authorization, in calendar months counted from the payer decision date. A payer approval that states an earlier valid-through date governs instead. A figure of 0 means the tier has no prior authorization.
- **Renewal lead**: the earliest point for submitting a prior authorization renewal, in calendar days before the valid-through date of the authorization being renewed. A figure of 0 means the tier has no prior authorization.
- **Standard decision time**: the payer's decision time for a standard prior authorization request, in calendar days counted from the request date. A figure of 0 means the tier has no prior authorization.
- **Expedited decision time**: the payer's decision time for an expedited prior authorization request, in hours counted from submission. A figure of 0 means the tier has no prior authorization.
- **Coverage re-verification**: how recently the coverage record must have been verified with the payer before a refill ships, in calendar months counted back from the ship date. A figure of 0 means there is no coverage to verify.
- **Referral documentation window**: the time allowed to complete the referral documentation, which is the written order on file and, where required, the prior authorization decided. It is counted in calendar days from the program's enrolled date.

## Schedule

| Basis | Continence Self-Pay Program | Continence Commercial HMO Program | Continence Commercial PPO Program | Continence Medicare Advantage Program | Continence Original Medicare Program | Continence Medicaid Program |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Order validity (months from order date) | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 12 |
| Prior authorization required | No | Yes | No | Yes | No | Yes |
| Authorization validity (months from decision) | 0 | 6 | 0 | 12 | 0 | 12 |
| Renewal lead (days before valid-through) | 0 | 30 | 0 | 30 | 0 | 30 |
| Standard decision time (days) | 0 | 15 | 0 | 7 | 0 | 7 |
| Expedited decision time (hours) | 0 | 72 | 0 | 72 | 0 | 72 |
| Coverage re-verification (months before ship date) | 0 | 6 | 12 | 12 | 12 | 1 |
| Referral documentation window (days from enrolled date) | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 | 30 |


## Points of reading

- The Continence Self-Pay Program, Continence Commercial PPO Program and Continence Original Medicare Program require no prior authorization. Their authorization timing figures are therefore 0.
- The Continence Self-Pay Program shows 0 for coverage re-verification because it has no coverage record to verify.
- **Hypothetical example:** on a tier with 6-month authorization validity, a payer approval decided in March runs six calendar months from its decision date. If the approval itself states an earlier valid-through date, that earlier date governs.
